title: Online Conditional Vine Copulas: Forecasting Electricity Demand
note: Abstract: online covariate-conditioned vine copula; simulations show online ~ batch accuracy at lower cost; GB net-demand across five regions beats unconditional Gaussian and vine benchmarks. Package ondil.

title: Online Conditional Vine Copulas (full text)
note: Application: one-step-ahead joint distribution of regional GB net-demand, extending Gioia et al.; test set is the whole of 2018 with monthly refits. Conditioning dependence on covariates drives gains. No week-ahead horizon.

title: chrischu12/online-vine-copulas replication package
note: Authors' replication scripts for simulations and application. GPL-3.0 with GPL submodules; input data (Gioia et al. Zenodo record) not redistributed. Authors' own code, not independent replication.
